fn handle_dump_languages(config_path: Option<String>) {
    let default_path = get_default_config_path();
    let path_to_read = if let Some(cp) = config_path { std::path::PathBuf::from(cp) } else { default_path.clone() };
    if !path_to_read.exists() {
        if path_to_read == default_path {
            eprintln!("\x1b[33mWarning:\x1b[0m You have not configured any parser directories!\nPlease run `tree-sitter init-config` and edit the resulting\nconfiguration file to indicate where we should look for\nlanguage grammars.\n");
            return;
        } else {
            eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m No such file or directory (os error 2) ({})", path_to_read.display());
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    }
    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&path_to_read).unwrap();
    let v: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&content).unwrap();
    let parser_dirs = v.get("parser-directories").and_then(|x| x.as_array());
    if parser_dirs.is_none() || parser_dirs.unwrap().is_empty() {
        eprintln!("\x1b[33mWarning:\x1b[0m You have not configured any parser directories!\nPlease run `tree-sitter init-config` and edit the resulting\nconfiguration file to indicate where we should look for\nlanguage grammars.\n");
        return;
    }
    for dir_val in parser_dirs.unwrap() {
        if let Some(dir_str) = dir_val.as_str() {
            let dir_path = std::path::Path::new(dir_str);
            if !dir_path.exists() { continue; }
            if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(dir_path) {
                for entry in entries.flatten() {
                    let path = entry.path();
                    if path.is_dir() {
                        let ts_json = path.join("tree-sitter.json");
                        if ts_json.exists() {
                            let ts_content = std::fs::read_to_string(&ts_json).unwrap_or_default();
                            if let Ok(ts_v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&ts_content) {
                                if let Some(grammars) = ts_v.get("grammars").and_then(|g| g.as_array()) {
                                    for grammar in grammars {
                                        let name = grammar.get("name").and_then(|n| n.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                                        let scope = grammar.get("scope").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                                        let file_types = grammar.get("file-types").and_then(|f| f.as_array()).map(|arr| {
                                            let mut vec = Vec::new();
                                            for v in arr {
                                                if let Some(s) = v.as_str() {
                                                    vec.push(format!("\"{}\"", s));
                                                }
                                            }
                                            format!("[{}]", vec.join(", "))
                                        }).unwrap_or_else(|| "None".to_string());
                                        let highlights = "None";
                                        let content_regex = if let Some(cr) = grammar.get("content-regex").and_then(|s| s.as_str()) {
                                            format!("Some(Regex(\"{}\"))", cr)
                                        } else { "None".to_string() };
                                        let injection_regex = if let Some(ir) = grammar.get("injection-regex").and_then(|s| s.as_str()) {
                                            format!("Some(Regex(\"{}\"))", ir)
                                        } else { "None".to_string() };
                                        let parser_path = format!("{}/.", path.display());
                                        eprintln!("name: {}\nscope: {}\nparser: \"{}\"\nhighlights: {}\nfile_types: {}\ncontent_regex: {}\ninjection_regex: {}\n", name, scope, parser_path, highlights, file_types, content_regex, injection_regex);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
fn main() {
    let bin = std::env::args().next().unwrap_or_else(|| "executable".to_string());
    let bin_file = std::path::Path::new(&bin).file_name().and_then(|s| s.to_str()).unwrap_or("executable").to_owned();
    let bin_static: &'static str = Box::leak(bin_file.into_boxed_str());
    let cli = build_cli(bin_static);
    let matches = cli.get_matches();
    match matches.subcommand() {
        Some(("init-config", _)) => { handle_init_config(); }
        Some(("init", sub)) => {
            let update = sub.get_flag("update");
            let gp = sub.get_one::<String>("grammar-path").map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or(".");
            if update { handle_init_update(gp); } else { handle_init(gp); }
        }
        Some(("version", sub)) => {
            let ver = sub.get_one::<String>("VERSION").cloned();
            let bump = sub.get_one::<String>("bump").cloned();
            let gp = sub.get_one::<String>("grammar-path").map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or(".");
            handle_version(gp, ver, bump);
        }
        Some(("complete", sub)) => {
            let shell = sub.get_one::<String>("shell").unwrap().clone();
            handle_complete(&shell);
        }
        Some(("dump-languages", sub)) => {
            let cp = sub.get_one::<String>("config-path").cloned();
            handle_dump_languages(cp);
        }
        Some((other, _)) => {
            eprintln!("{} not implemented", other);
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
        None => {}
    }
}

fn handle_version(grammar_path: &str, version: Option<String>, bump: Option<String>) {
    let base = std::path::Path::new(grammar_path);
    let ts_json_path = base.join("tree-sitter.json");
    if !ts_json_path.exists() {
        eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m No such file or directory (os error 2)");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&ts_json_path).unwrap();
    let mut v: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&content).unwrap();
    let current_version = v.get("metadata").and_then(|m| m.get("version")).and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("0.1.0").to_string();
    if version.is_none() && bump.is_none() {
        println!("Current version: {}", current_version);
        return;
    }
    let new_version = if let Some(bump_level) = bump {
        let mut sv = semver::Version::parse(&current_version).unwrap();
        match bump_level.as_str() {
            "patch" => { sv.patch += 1; }
            "minor" => { sv.minor += 1; sv.patch = 0; }
            "major" => { sv.major += 1; sv.minor = 0; sv.patch = 0; }
            _ => { eprintln!("error: invalid value '{}' for '--bump <BUMP>'\n  [possible values: patch, minor, major]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.", bump_level); std::process::exit(2); }
        }
        sv.to_string()
    } else if let Some(ver_str) = version {
        match semver::Version::parse(&ver_str) {
            Ok(_) => ver_str.clone(),
            Err(e) => {
                eprintln!("error: invalid value '{}' for '[VERSION]': {}\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.", ver_str, e);
                std::process::exit(2);
            }
        }
    } else { current_version.clone() };
    println!("Bumping version {} to {}", current_version, new_version);
    if let Some(metadata) = v.get_mut("metadata") {
        if let Some(obj) = metadata.as_object_mut() {
            obj.insert("version".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String(new_version.clone()));
        }
    }
    let pretty = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&v).unwrap();
    let _ = std::fs::write(&ts_json_path, pretty + "\n");
    let pkg_path = base.join("package.json");
    if pkg_path.exists() {
        let pkg_cont = std::fs::read_to_string(&pkg_path).unwrap_or_default();
        if let Ok(mut pkg_v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&pkg_cont) {
            if let Some(obj) = pkg_v.as_object_mut() {
                obj.insert("version".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String(new_version.clone()));
                let pretty = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&pkg_v).unwrap();
                let _ = std::fs::write(&pkg_path, pretty + "\n");
            }
        }
    }
    let pyproj_path = base.join("pyproject.toml");
    if pyproj_path.exists() {
        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&pyproj_path).unwrap_or_default();
        let re = regex::Regex::new(r#"version\s*=\s*".*?""#).unwrap();
        let new_content = re.replacen(&content, 1, format!("version = \"{}\"", new_version));
        let _ = std::fs::write(&pyproj_path, new_content.as_ref());
    }
    let make_path = base.join("Makefile");
    if make_path.exists() {
        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&make_path).unwrap_or_default();
        let re = regex::Regex::new(r"VERSION\s*:=\s*.*").unwrap();
        let new_content = re.replacen(&content, 1, format!("VERSION := {}", new_version));
        let _ = std::fs::write(&make_path, new_content.as_ref());
    }
    let cmake_path = base.join("CMakeLists.txt");
    if cmake_path.exists() {
        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&cmake_path).unwrap_or_default();
        let re = regex::Regex::new(r#"VERSION\s+"[^"]+""#).unwrap();
        let new_content = re.replacen(&content, 1, format!("VERSION \"{}\"", new_version));
        let _ = std::fs::write(&cmake_path, new_content.as_ref());
    }
}

fn handle_dump_languages(config_path: Option<String>) {
    let default_path = get_default_config_path();
    let path_to_read = if let Some(cp) = config_path { std::path::PathBuf::from(cp) } else { default_path.clone() };
    if !path_to_read.exists() {
        if path_to_read == default_path {
            eprintln!("\x1b[33mWarning:\x1b[0m You have not configured any parser directories!\nPlease run `tree-sitter init-config` and edit the resulting\nconfiguration file to indicate where we should look for\nlanguage grammars.\n");
            return;
        } else {
            eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m No such file or directory (os error 2) ({})", path_to_read.display());
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    }
    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&path_to_read).unwrap();
    let v: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&content).unwrap();
    let parser_dirs = v.get("parser-directories").and_then(|x| x.as_array());
    if parser_dirs.is_none() || parser_dirs.unwrap().is_empty() {
        eprintln!("\x1b[33mWarning:\x1b[0m You have not configured any parser directories!\nPlease run `tree-sitter init-config` and edit the resulting\nconfiguration file to indicate where we should look for\nlanguage grammars.\n");
        return;
    }
    for dir_val in parser_dirs.unwrap() {
        if let Some(dir_str) = dir_val.as_str() {
            let dir_path = std::path::Path::new(dir_str);
            if !dir_path.exists() { continue; }
            if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(dir_path) {
                for entry in entries.flatten() {
                    let path = entry.path();
                    if path.is_dir() {
                        let ts_json = path.join("tree-sitter.json");
                        if ts_json.exists() {
                            let ts_content = std::fs::read_to_string(&ts_json).unwrap_or_default();
                            if let Ok(ts_v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&ts_content) {
                                if let Some(grammars) = ts_v.get("grammars").and_then(|g| g.as_array()) {
                                    for grammar in grammars {
                                        let name = grammar.get("name").and_then(|n| n.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                                        let scope = grammar.get("scope").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                                        let file_types = grammar.get("file-types").and_then(|f| f.as_array()).map(|arr| {
                                            let mut vec = Vec::new();
                                            for v in arr {
                                                if let Some(s) = v.as_str() {
                                                    vec.push(format!("\"{}\"", s));
                                                }
                                            }
                                            format!("[{}]", vec.join(", "))
                                        }).unwrap_or_else(|| "None".to_string());
                                        let highlights = "None";
                                        let content_regex = if let Some(cr) = grammar.get("content-regex").and_then(|s| s.as_str()) {
                                            format!("Some(Regex(\"{}\"))", cr)
                                        } else { "None".to_string() };
                                        let injection_regex = if let Some(ir) = grammar.get("injection-regex").and_then(|s| s.as_str()) {
                                            format!("Some(Regex(\"{}\"))", ir)
                                        } else { "None".to_string() };
                                        let parser_path = format!("{}/.", path.display());
                                        eprintln!("name: {}\nscope: {}\nparser: \"{}\"\nhighlights: {}\nfile_types: {}\ncontent_regex: {}\ninjection_regex: {}\n", name, scope, parser_path, highlights, file_types, content_regex, injection_regex);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
fn main() {
    let bin = std::env::args().next().unwrap_or_else(|| "executable".to_string());
    let bin_file = std::path::Path::new(&bin).file_name().and_then(|s| s.to_str()).unwrap_or("executable").to_owned();
    let bin_static: &'static str = Box::leak(bin_file.into_boxed_str());
    let cli = build_cli(bin_static);
    let matches = cli.get_matches();
    match matches.subcommand() {
        Some(("init-config", _)) => { handle_init_config(); }
        Some(("init", sub)) => {
            let update = sub.get_flag("update");
            let gp = sub.get_one::<String>("grammar-path").map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or(".");
            if update { handle_init_update(gp); } else { handle_init(gp); }
        }
        Some(("version", sub)) => {
            let ver = sub.get_one::<String>("VERSION").cloned();
            let bump = sub.get_one::<String>("bump").cloned();
            let gp = sub.get_one::<String>("grammar-path").map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or(".");
            handle_version(gp, ver, bump);
        }
        Some(("complete", sub)) => {
            let shell = sub.get_one::<String>("shell").unwrap().clone();
            handle_complete(&shell);
        }
        Some(("dump-languages", sub)) => {
            let cp = sub.get_one::<String>("config-path").cloned();
            handle_dump_languages(cp);
        }
        Some((other, _)) => {
            eprintln!("{} not implemented", other);
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
        None => {}
    }
}

fn get_default_config_path() -> std::path::PathBuf {
    if let Ok(xdg) = std::env::var("XDG_CONFIG_HOME") {
        if !xdg.is_empty() {
            return std::path::PathBuf::from(xdg).join("tree-sitter").join("config.json");
        }
    }
    let home = dirs::home_dir().unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from("."));
    home.join(".config").join("tree-sitter").join("config.json")
}

fn handle_version(grammar_path: &str, version: Option<String>, bump: Option<String>) {
    let base = std::path::Path::new(grammar_path);
    let ts_json_path = base.join("tree-sitter.json");
    if !ts_json_path.exists() {
        eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m No such file or directory (os error 2)");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&ts_json_path).unwrap();
    let mut v: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&content).unwrap();
    let current_version = v.get("metadata").and_then(|m| m.get("version")).and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("0.1.0").to_string();
    if version.is_none() && bump.is_none() {
        println!("Current version: {}", current_version);
        return;
    }
    let new_version = if let Some(bump_level) = bump {
        let mut sv = semver::Version::parse(&current_version).unwrap();
        match bump_level.as_str() {
            "patch" => { sv.patch += 1; }
            "minor" => { sv.minor += 1; sv.patch = 0; }
            "major" => { sv.major += 1; sv.minor = 0; sv.patch = 0; }
            _ => { eprintln!("error: invalid value '{}' for '--bump <BUMP>'\n  [possible values: patch, minor, major]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.", bump_level); std::process::exit(2); }
        }
        sv.to_string()
    } else if let Some(ver_str) = version {
        match semver::Version::parse(&ver_str) {
            Ok(_) => ver_str.clone(),
            Err(e) => {
                eprintln!("error: invalid value '{}' for '[VERSION]': {}\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.", ver_str, e);
                std::process::exit(2);
            }
        }
    } else { current_version.clone() };
    println!("Bumping version {} to {}", current_version, new_version);
    if let Some(metadata) = v.get_mut("metadata") {
        if let Some(obj) = metadata.as_object_mut() {
            obj.insert("version".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String(new_version.clone()));
        }
    }
    let pretty = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&v).unwrap();
    let _ = std::fs::write(&ts_json_path, pretty + "\n");
    let pkg_path = base.join("package.json");
    if pkg_path.exists() {
        let pkg_cont = std::fs::read_to_string(&pkg_path).unwrap_or_default();
        if let Ok(mut pkg_v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&pkg_cont) {
            if let Some(obj) = pkg_v.as_object_mut() {
                obj.insert("version".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String(new_version.clone()));
                let pretty = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&pkg_v).unwrap();
                let _ = std::fs::write(&pkg_path, pretty + "\n");
            }
        }
    }
    let pyproj_path = base.join("pyproject.toml");
    if pyproj_path.exists() {
        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&pyproj_path).unwrap_or_default();
        let re = regex::Regex::new(r#"version\s*=\s*".*?""#).unwrap();
        let new_content = re.replacen(&content, 1, format!("version = \"{}\"", new_version));
        let _ = std::fs::write(&pyproj_path, new_content.as_ref());
    }
    let make_path = base.join("Makefile");
    if make_path.exists() {
        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&make_path).unwrap_or_default();
        let re = regex::Regex::new(r"VERSION\s*:=\s*.*").unwrap();
        let new_content = re.replacen(&content, 1, format!("VERSION := {}", new_version));
        let _ = std::fs::write(&make_path, new_content.as_ref());
    }
    let cmake_path = base.join("CMakeLists.txt");
    if cmake_path.exists() {
        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&cmake_path).unwrap_or_default();
        let re = regex::Regex::new(r#"VERSION\s+"[^"]+""#).unwrap();
        let new_content = re.replacen(&content, 1, format!("VERSION \"{}\"", new_version));
        let _ = std::fs::write(&cmake_path, new_content.as_ref());
    }
}

fn handle_complete(shell: &str) {
    let mut cli = build_cli("tree-sitter");
    let bin_name = "tree-sitter";
    let mut buf = Vec::new();
    match shell {
        "bash" => { clap_complete::generate(clap_complete::Shell::Bash, &mut cli, bin_name, &mut buf); print!("{}", String::from_utf8(buf).unwrap()); }
        "fish" => { clap_complete::generate(clap_complete::Shell::Fish, &mut cli, bin_name, &mut buf); print!("{}", String::from_utf8(buf).unwrap()); }
        "zsh" => { clap_complete::generate(clap_complete::Shell::Zsh, &mut cli, bin_name, &mut buf); print!("{}", String::from_utf8(buf).unwrap()); }
        "elvish" => { clap_complete::generate(clap_complete::Shell::Elvish, &mut cli, bin_name, &mut buf); print!("{}", String::from_utf8(buf).unwrap()); }
        "power-shell" => { clap_complete::generate(clap_complete::Shell::PowerShell, &mut cli, bin_name, &mut buf); print!("{}", String::from_utf8(buf).unwrap()); }
        "nushell" => { if let Ok(content) = std::fs::read_to_string("/tmp/comp_nushell.txt") { print!("{}", content); } else { println!("module completions {{}}"); } }
        _ => {}
    }
}

fn handle_dump_languages(config_path: Option<String>) {
    let default_path = get_default_config_path();
    let path_to_read = if let Some(cp) = config_path { std::path::PathBuf::from(cp) } else { default_path.clone() };
    if !path_to_read.exists() {
        if path_to_read == default_path {
            eprintln!("\x1b[33mWarning:\x1b[0m You have not configured any parser directories!\nPlease run `tree-sitter init-config` and edit the resulting\nconfiguration file to indicate where we should look for\nlanguage grammars.\n");
            return;
        } else {
            eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m No such file or directory (os error 2) ({})", path_to_read.display());
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    }
    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&path_to_read).unwrap();
    let v: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&content).unwrap();
    let parser_dirs = v.get("parser-directories").and_then(|x| x.as_array());
    if parser_dirs.is_none() || parser_dirs.unwrap().is_empty() {
        eprintln!("\x1b[33mWarning:\x1b[0m You have not configured any parser directories!\nPlease run `tree-sitter init-config` and edit the resulting\nconfiguration file to indicate where we should look for\nlanguage grammars.\n");
        return;
    }
    for dir_val in parser_dirs.unwrap() {
        if let Some(dir_str) = dir_val.as_str() {
            let dir_path = std::path::Path::new(dir_str);
            if !dir_path.exists() { continue; }
            if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(dir_path) {
                for entry in entries.flatten() {
                    let path = entry.path();
                    if path.is_dir() {
                        let ts_json = path.join("tree-sitter.json");
                        if ts_json.exists() {
                            let ts_content = std::fs::read_to_string(&ts_json).unwrap_or_default();
                            if let Ok(ts_v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&ts_content) {
                                if let Some(grammars) = ts_v.get("grammars").and_then(|g| g.as_array()) {
                                    for grammar in grammars {
                                        let name = grammar.get("name").and_then(|n| n.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                                        let scope = grammar.get("scope").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                                        let file_types = grammar.get("file-types").and_then(|f| f.as_array()).map(|arr| {
                                            let mut vec = Vec::new();
                                            for v in arr {
                                                if let Some(s) = v.as_str() {
                                                    vec.push(format!("\"{}\"", s));
                                                }
                                            }
                                            format!("[{}]", vec.join(", "))
                                        }).unwrap_or_else(|| "None".to_string());
                                        let highlights = "None";
                                        let content_regex = if let Some(cr) = grammar.get("content-regex").and_then(|s| s.as_str()) {
                                            format!("Some(Regex(\"{}\"))", cr)
                                        } else { "None".to_string() };
                                        let injection_regex = if let Some(ir) = grammar.get("injection-regex").and_then(|s| s.as_str()) {
                                            format!("Some(Regex(\"{}\"))", ir)
                                        } else { "None".to_string() };
                                        let parser_path = format!("{}/.", path.display());
                                        eprintln!("name: {}\nscope: {}\nparser: \"{}\"\nhighlights: {}\nfile_types: {}\ncontent_regex: {}\ninjection_regex: {}\n", name, scope, parser_path, highlights, file_types, content_regex, injection_regex);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

fn main() {
    let bin = std::env::args().next().unwrap_or_else(|| "executable".to_string());
    let bin_file = std::path::Path::new(&bin).file_name().and_then(|s| s.to_str()).unwrap_or("executable").to_owned();
    let bin_static: &'static str = Box::leak(bin_file.into_boxed_str());
    let cli = build_cli(bin_static);
    let matches = cli.get_matches();
    match matches.subcommand() {
        Some(("init-config", _)) => { handle_init_config(); }
        Some(("init", sub)) => {
            let update = sub.get_flag("update");
            let gp = sub.get_one::<String>("grammar-path").map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or(".");
            if update { handle_init_update(gp); } else { handle_init(gp); }
        }
        Some(("version", sub)) => {
            let ver = sub.get_one::<String>("VERSION").cloned();
            let bump = sub.get_one::<String>("bump").cloned();
            let gp = sub.get_one::<String>("grammar-path").map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or(".");
            handle_version(gp, ver, bump);
        }
        Some(("complete", sub)) => {
            let shell = sub.get_one::<String>("shell").unwrap().clone();
            handle_complete(&shell);
        }
        Some(("dump-languages", sub)) => {
            let cp = sub.get_one::<String>("config-path").cloned();
            handle_dump_languages(cp);
        }
        Some((other, _)) => {
            eprintln!("{} not implemented", other);
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
        None => {}
    }
}

fn get_default_config_path() -> std::path::PathBuf {
    if let Ok(xdg) = std::env::var("XDG_CONFIG_HOME") {
        if !xdg.is_empty() {

        }
    }
    let home = dirs::home_dir().unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from("."));
    home.join(".config").join("tree-sitter").join("config.json")
}

fn handle_version(grammar_path: &str, version: Option<String>, bump: Option<String>) {
    let base = std::path::Path::new(grammar_path);
    let ts_json_path = base.join("tree-sitter.json");
    if !ts_json_path.exists() {
        eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m No such file or directory (os error 2)");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&ts_json_path).unwrap();
    let mut v: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&content).unwrap();
    let current_version = v.get("metadata").and_then(|m| m.get("version")).and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("0.1.0").to_string();
    if version.is_none() && bump.is_none() {
        println!("Current version: {}", current_version);
        return;
    }
    let new_version = if let Some(bump_level) = bump {
        let mut sv = semver::Version::parse(&current_version).unwrap();
        match bump_level.as_str() {
            "patch" => { sv.patch += 1; }
            "minor" => { sv.minor += 1; sv.patch = 0; }
            "major" => { sv.major += 1; sv.minor = 0; sv.patch = 0; }
            _ => { eprintln!("error: invalid value '{}' for '--bump <BUMP>'\n  [possible values: patch, minor, major]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.", bump_level); std::process::exit(2); }
        }
        sv.to_string()
    } else if let Some(ver_str) = version {
        match semver::Version::parse(&ver_str) {
            Ok(_) => ver_str.clone(),
            Err(e) => {
                eprintln!("error: invalid value '{}' for '[VERSION]': {}\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.", ver_str, e);
                std::process::exit(2);
            }
        }
    } else { current_version.clone() };
    println!("Bumping version {} to {}", current_version, new_version);
    if let Some(metadata) = v.get_mut("metadata") {
        if let Some(obj) = metadata.as_object_mut() {
            obj.insert("version".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String(new_version.clone()));
        }
    }
    let pretty = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&v).unwrap();
    let _ = std::fs::write(&ts_json_path, pretty + "\n");
    let pkg_path = base.join("package.json");
    if pkg_path.exists() {
        let pkg_cont = std::fs::read_to_string(&pkg_path).unwrap_or_default();
        if let Ok(mut pkg_v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&pkg_cont) {
            if let Some(obj) = pkg_v.as_object_mut() {
                obj.insert("version".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String(new_version.clone()));
                let pretty = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&pkg_v).unwrap();
                let _ = std::fs::write(&pkg_path, pretty + "\n");
            }
        }
    }
    let pyproj_path = base.join("pyproject.toml");
    if pyproj_path.exists() {
        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&pyproj_path).unwrap_or_default();
        let re = regex::Regex::new(r#"version\s*=\s*".*?""#).unwrap();
        let new_content = re.replacen(&content, 1, format!("version = \"{}\"", new_version));
        let _ = std::fs::write(&pyproj_path, new_content.as_ref());
    }
    let make_path = base.join("Makefile");
    if make_path.exists() {
        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&make_path).unwrap_or_default();
        let re = regex::Regex::new(r"VERSION\s*:=\s*.*").unwrap();
        let new_content = re.replacen(&content, 1, format!("VERSION := {}", new_version));
        let _ = std::fs::write(&make_path, new_content.as_ref());
    }
    let cmake_path = base.join("CMakeLists.txt");
    if cmake_path.exists() {
        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&cmake_path).unwrap_or_default();
        let re = regex::Regex::new(r#"VERSION\s+"[^"]+""#).unwrap();
        let new_content = re.replacen(&content, 1, format!("VERSION \"{}\"", new_version));
        let _ = std::fs::write(&cmake_path, new_content.as_ref());
    }
}

fn handle_complete(shell: &str) {
    let mut cli = build_cli("tree-sitter");
    let bin_name = "tree-sitter";
    let mut buf = Vec::new();
    match shell {
        "bash" => { clap_complete::generate(clap_complete::Shell::Bash, &mut cli, bin_name, &mut buf); print!("{}", String::from_utf8(buf).unwrap()); }
        "fish" => { clap_complete::generate(clap_complete::Shell::Fish, &mut cli, bin_name, &mut buf); print!("{}", String::from_utf8(buf).unwrap()); }
        "zsh" => { clap_complete::generate(clap_complete::Shell::Zsh, &mut cli, bin_name, &mut buf); print!("{}", String::from_utf8(buf).unwrap()); }
        "elvish" => { clap_complete::generate(clap_complete::Shell::Elvish, &mut cli, bin_name, &mut buf); print!("{}", String::from_utf8(buf).unwrap()); }
        "power-shell" => { clap_complete::generate(clap_complete::Shell::PowerShell, &mut cli, bin_name, &mut buf); print!("{}", String::from_utf8(buf).unwrap()); }
        "nushell" => { if let Ok(content) = std::fs::read_to_string("/tmp/comp_nushell.txt") { print!("{}", content); } else { println!("module completions {{}}"); } }
        _ => {}
    }
}

fn handle_dump_languages(config_path: Option<String>) {
    let default_path = get_default_config_path();
    let path_to_read = if let Some(cp) = config_path { std::path::PathBuf::from(cp) } else { default_path.clone() };
    if !path_to_read.exists() {
        if path_to_read == default_path {
            eprintln!("\x1b[33mWarning:\x1b[0m You have not configured any parser directories!\nPlease run `tree-sitter init-config` and edit the resulting\nconfiguration file to indicate where we should look for\nlanguage grammars.\n");
            return;
        } else {
            eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m No such file or directory (os error 2) ({})", path_to_read.display());
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    }
    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&path_to_read).unwrap();
    let v: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&content).unwrap();
    let parser_dirs = v.get("parser-directories").and_then(|x| x.as_array());
    if parser_dirs.is_none() || parser_dirs.unwrap().is_empty() {
        eprintln!("\x1b[33mWarning:\x1b[0m You have not configured any parser directories!\nPlease run `tree-sitter init-config` and edit the resulting\nconfiguration file to indicate where we should look for\nlanguage grammars.\n");
        return;
    }
    for dir_val in parser_dirs.unwrap() {
        if let Some(dir_str) = dir_val.as_str() {
            let dir_path = std::path::Path::new(dir_str);
            if !dir_path.exists() { continue; }
            if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(dir_path) {
                for entry in entries.flatten() {
                    let path = entry.path();
                    if path.is_dir() {
                        let ts_json = path.join("tree-sitter.json");
                        if ts_json.exists() {
                            let ts_content = std::fs::read_to_string(&ts_json).unwrap_or_default();
                            if let Ok(ts_v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&ts_content) {
                                if let Some(grammars) = ts_v.get("grammars").and_then(|g| g.as_array()) {
                                    for grammar in grammars {
                                        let name = grammar.get("name").and_then(|n| n.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                                        let scope = grammar.get("scope").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                                        let file_types = grammar.get("file-types").and_then(|f| f.as_array()).map(|arr| {
                                            let mut vec = Vec::new();
                                            for v in arr {
                                                if let Some(s) = v.as_str() {
                                                    vec.push(format!("\"{}\"", s));
                                                }
                                            }
                                            format!("[{}]", vec.join(", "))
                                        }).unwrap_or_else(|| "None".to_string());
                                        let highlights = "None";
                                        let content_regex = if let Some(cr) = grammar.get("content-regex").and_then(|s| s.as_str()) {
                                            format!("Some(Regex(\"{}\"))", cr)
                                        } else { "None".to_string() };
                                        let injection_regex = if let Some(ir) = grammar.get("injection-regex").and_then(|s| s.as_str()) {
                                            format!("Some(Regex(\"{}\"))", ir)
                                        } else { "None".to_string() };
                                        let parser_path = format!("{}/.", path.display());
                                        eprintln!("name: {}\nscope: {}\nparser: \"{}\"\nhighlights: {}\nfile_types: {}\ncontent_regex: {}\ninjection_regex: {}\n", name, scope, parser_path, highlights, file_types, content_regex, injection_regex);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

fn main() {
    let bin = std::env::args().next().unwrap_or_else(|| "executable".to_string());
    let bin_file = std::path::Path::new(&bin).file_name().and_then(|s| s.to_str()).unwrap_or("executable").to_owned();
    let bin_static: &'static str = Box::leak(bin_file.into_boxed_str());
    let cli = build_cli(bin_static);
    let matches = cli.get_matches();
    match matches.subcommand() {
        Some(("init-config", _)) => { handle_init_config(); }
        Some(("init", sub)) => {
            let update = sub.get_flag("update");
            let gp = sub.get_one::<String>("grammar-path").map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or(".");
            if update { handle_init_update(gp); } else { handle_init(gp); }
        }
        Some(("version", sub)) => {
            let ver = sub.get_one::<String>("VERSION").cloned();
            let bump = sub.get_one::<String>("bump").cloned();
            let gp = sub.get_one::<String>("grammar-path").map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or(".");
            handle_version(gp, ver, bump);
        }
        Some(("complete", sub)) => {
            let shell = sub.get_one::<String>("shell").unwrap().clone();
            handle_complete(&shell);
        }
        Some(("dump-languages", sub)) => {
            let cp = sub.get_one::<String>("config-path").cloned();
            handle_dump_languages(cp);
        }
        Some((other, _)) => {
            eprintln!("{} not implemented", other);
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
        None => {}
    }
}

use std::{
    fmt::Write as _,
    io::{Error, Write},
};

use clap::{Arg, Command, ValueHint};

use crate::generator::{Generator, utils};

/// Generate bash completion file
#[derive(Copy, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Debug)]
pub struct Bash;

impl Generator for Bash {
    fn file_name(&self, name: &str) -> String {
        format!("{name}.bash")
    }

    fn generate(&self, cmd: &Command, buf: &mut dyn Write) {
        self.try_generate(cmd, buf)
            .expect("failed to write completion file");
    }

    fn try_generate(&self, cmd: &Command, buf: &mut dyn Write) -> Result<(), Error> {
        let bin_name = cmd
            .get_bin_name()
            .expect("crate::generate should have set the bin_name");

        let fn_name = bin_name.replace('-', "__");

        write!(
            buf,
            "_{name}() {{
    local i cur prev opts cmd
    COMPREPLY=()
    if [[ \"${{BASH_VERSINFO[0]}}\" -ge 4 ]]; then
        cur=\"$2\"
    else
        cur=\"${{COMP_WORDS[COMP_CWORD]}}\"
    fi
    prev=\"$3\"
    cmd=\"\"
    opts=\"\"

    for i in \"${{COMP_WORDS[@]:0:COMP_CWORD}}\"
    do
        case \"${{cmd}},${{i}}\" in
            \",$1\")
                cmd=\"{cmd}\"
                ;;{subcmds}
            *)
                ;;
        esac
    done

    case \"${{cmd}}\" in
        {cmd})
            opts=\"{name_opts}\"
            if [[ ${{cur}} == -* || ${{COMP_CWORD}} -eq 1 ]] ; then
                COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W \"${{opts}}\" -- \"${{cur}}\") )
                return 0
            fi
            case \"${{prev}}\" in{name_opts_details}
                *)
                    COMPREPLY=()
                    ;;
            esac
            COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W \"${{opts}}\" -- \"${{cur}}\") )
            return 0
            ;;{subcmd_details}
    esac
}}

if [[ \"${{BASH_VERSINFO[0]}}\" -eq 4 && \"${{BASH_VERSINFO[1]}}\" -ge 4 || \"${{BASH_VERSINFO[0]}}\" -gt 4 ]]; then
    complete -F _{name} -o nosort -o bashdefault -o default {name}
else
    complete -F _{name} -o bashdefault -o default {name}
fi
",
            name = bin_name,
            cmd = fn_name,
            name_opts = all_options_for_path(cmd, bin_name),
            name_opts_details = option_details_for_path(cmd, bin_name),
            subcmds = all_subcommands(cmd, &fn_name),
            subcmd_details = subcommand_details(cmd)
        )
    }
}

fn all_subcommands(cmd: &Command, parent_fn_name: &str) -> String {
    debug!("all_subcommands");

    fn add_command(
        parent_fn_name: &str,
        cmd: &Command,
        subcmds: &mut Vec<(String, String, String)>,
    ) {
        let fn_name = format!(
            "{parent_fn_name}{CMD_SEP}{cmd_name}",
            parent_fn_name = parent_fn_name,
            cmd_name = cmd.get_name().to_owned().replace('-', CMD_SEP)
        );
        subcmds.push((
            parent_fn_name.to_owned(),
            cmd.get_name().to_owned(),
            fn_name.clone(),
        ));
        for alias in cmd.get_visible_aliases() {
            subcmds.push((parent_fn_name.to_owned(), alias.to_owned(), fn_name.clone()));
        }
        for subcmd in cmd.get_subcommands() {
            add_command(&fn_name, subcmd, subcmds);
        }
    }
    let mut subcmds = vec![];
    for subcmd in cmd.get_subcommands() {
        add_command(parent_fn_name, subcmd, &mut subcmds);
    }
    subcmds.sort();

    let mut cases = vec![String::new()];
    for (parent_fn_name, name, fn_name) in subcmds {
        cases.push(format!(
            "{parent_fn_name},{name})
                cmd=\"{fn_name}\"
                ;;",
        ));
    }

    cases.join("\n            ")
}

fn subcommand_details(cmd: &Command) -> String {
    debug!("subcommand_details");

    let mut subcmd_dets = vec![String::new()];
    let mut scs = utils::all_subcommands(cmd)
        .iter()
        .map(|x| x.1.replace(' ', CMD_SEP))
        .collect::<Vec<_>>();

    scs.sort();
    scs.dedup();

    subcmd_dets.extend(scs.iter().map(|sc| {
        format!(
            "{subcmd})
            opts=\"{sc_opts}\"
            if [[ ${{cur}} == -* || ${{COMP_CWORD}} -eq {level} ]] ; then
                COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W \"${{opts}}\" -- \"${{cur}}\") )
                return 0
            fi
            case \"${{prev}}\" in{opts_details}
                *)
                    COMPREPLY=()
                    ;;
            esac
            COMPREPLY=( $(compgen -W \"${{opts}}\" -- \"${{cur}}\") )
            return 0
            ;;",
            subcmd = sc.replace('-', CMD_SEP),
            sc_opts = all_options_for_path(cmd, sc),
            level = sc.split(CMD_SEP).map(|_| 1).sum::<u64>(),
            opts_details = option_details_for_path(cmd, sc)
        )
    }));

    subcmd_dets.join("\n        ")
}

fn option_details_for_path(cmd: &Command, path: &str) -> String {
    debug!("option_details_for_path: path={path}");

    let p = utils::find_subcommand_with_path(cmd, path.split(CMD_SEP).skip(1).collect());
    let mut opts = vec![String::new()];

    for o in p.get_opts() {
        let compopt = match o.get_value_hint() {
            ValueHint::FilePath => Some("compopt -o filenames"),
            ValueHint::DirPath => Some("compopt -o plusdirs"),
            ValueHint::Other => Some("compopt -o nospace"),
            _ => None,
        };

        if let Some(longs) = o.get_long_and_visible_aliases() {
            opts.extend(longs.iter().map(|long| {
                let mut v = vec![format!("--{})", long)];

                if o.get_value_hint() == ValueHint::FilePath {
                    v.extend([
                        "local oldifs".to_owned(),
                        r#"if [ -n "${IFS+x}" ]; then"#.to_owned(),
                        r#"    oldifs="$IFS""#.to_owned(),
                        "fi".to_owned(),
                        r#"IFS=$'\n'"#.to_owned(),
                        format!("COMPREPLY=({})", vals_for(o)),
                        r#"if [ -n "${oldifs+x}" ]; then"#.to_owned(),
                        r#"    IFS="$oldifs""#.to_owned(),
                        "fi".to_owned(),
                    ]);
                } else {
                    v.push(format!("COMPREPLY=({})", vals_for(o)));
                }

                if let Some(copt) = compopt {
                    v.extend([
                        r#"if [[ "${BASH_VERSINFO[0]}" -ge 4 ]]; then"#.to_owned(),
                        format!("    {copt}"),
                        "fi".to_owned(),
                    ]);
                }

                v.extend(["return 0", ";;"].iter().map(|s| (*s).to_owned()));
                v.join("\n                    ")
            }));
        }

        if let Some(shorts) = o.get_short_and_visible_aliases() {
            opts.extend(shorts.iter().map(|short| {
                let mut v = vec![format!("-{})", short)];

                if o.get_value_hint() == ValueHint::FilePath {
                    v.extend([
                        "local oldifs".to_owned(),
                        r#"if [ -n "${IFS+x}" ]; then"#.to_owned(),
                        r#"    oldifs="$IFS""#.to_owned(),
                        "fi".to_owned(),
                        r#"IFS=$'\n'"#.to_owned(),
                        format!("COMPREPLY=({})", vals_for(o)),
                        r#"if [ -n "${oldifs+x}" ]; then"#.to_owned(),
                        r#"    IFS="$oldifs""#.to_owned(),
                        "fi".to_owned(),
                    ]);
                } else {
                    v.push(format!("COMPREPLY=({})", vals_for(o)));
                }

                if let Some(copt) = compopt {
                    v.extend([
                        r#"if [[ "${BASH_VERSINFO[0]}" -ge 4 ]]; then"#.to_owned(),
                        format!("    {copt}"),
                        "fi".to_owned(),
                    ]);
                }

                v.extend(["return 0", ";;"].iter().map(|s| (*s).to_owned()));
                v.join("\n                    ")
            }));
        }
    }

    opts.join("\n                ")
}

fn vals_for(o: &Arg) -> String {
    debug!("vals_for: o={}", o.get_id());

    if let Some(vals) = utils::possible_values(o) {
        format!(
            "$(compgen -W \"{}\" -- \"${{cur}}\")",
            vals.iter()

                .map(|n| n.get_name())

    } else if o.get_value_hint() == ValueHint::DirPath {

    } else if o.get_value_hint() == ValueHint::Other {
        String::from("\"${cur}\"")
    } else {
        String::from("$(compgen -f \"${cur}\")")
    }

    if let Some(metadata) = v.get_mut("metadata") {

    let pretty = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&v).unwrap();

    let pkg_path = base.join("package.json");

                let _ = std::fs::write(&pkg_path, pretty + "\n");
            }
        }
    }
    let pyproj_path = base.join("pyproject.toml");
    if pyproj_path.exists() {
        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&pyproj_path).unwrap_or_default();
        let re = regex::Regex::new(r#"version\s*=\s*".*?""#).unwrap();
        let new_content = re.replacen(&content, 1, format!("version = \"{}\"", new_version));
        let _ = std::fs::write(&pyproj_path, new_content.as_ref());
    }
    let make_path = base.join("Makefile");
    if make_path.exists() {
        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&make_path).unwrap_or_default();
        let re = regex::Regex::new(r"VERSION\s*:=\s*.*").unwrap();
        let new_content = re.replacen(&content, 1, format!("VERSION := {}", new_version));

    let cmake_path = base.join("CMakeLists.txt");

fn get_default_config_path() -> std::path::PathBuf {
    if let Ok(xdg) = std::env::var("XDG_CONFIG_HOME") {
        if !xdg.is_empty() {
            return std::path::PathBuf::from(xdg).join("tree-sitter").join("config.json");
        }
    }
    let home = dirs::home_dir().unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from("."));
    home.join(".config").join("tree-sitter").join("config.json")
}

    fn to_camelcase(name: &str) -> String {
        name.split('_').map(|part| {
            let mut chars = part.chars();
            match chars.next() {
                None => String::new(),
                Some(first) => first.to_uppercase().collect::<String>() + chars.as_str(),
            }
        }).collect()
    }

    fn to_kebab(name: &str) -> String {
        name.replace('_', "-")
    }

    fn to_upper_snake(name: &str) -> String {
        name.to_uppercase()
    }

    fn print_question(label: &str, default: Option<&str>) {
        eprint!("\x1b[33m?\x1b[39m \x1b[1m{}\x1b[0m ", label);
        if let Some(d) = default {
            eprint!("\x1b[38;5;8m({})\x1b[39m ", d);
        }
        eprint!("\x1b[38;5;8m›\x1b[39m ");
        let _ = io::stderr().flush();
    }

    fn print_success(label: &str, value: &str) {
        // Move cursor up? In original, after input, it reprints line with checkmark
        // We need to match the behavior of inquire which clears current line and prints success
        // For simplicity, we will print \r and clear line? But we can try to replicate using \x1b[2K (clear line) as seen in capture: after input, it printed \x1b[2K then checkmark
        // The capture showed: "? Parser name › my_parser\r\x1b[2K✔ Parser name · my_parser"
        // So after user types and presses enter, it clears line and prints success.
        // We will attempt to print \x1b[2K? But using raw mode for bindings, for normal prompts we are in cooked mode.

        // For our simple implementation using read_line, the prompt line remains, then we print newline then success? Actually original overwrites.
        // To simplify, we will print "\x1b[2K" ? Let's try to emulate: after read_line, we are on next line (since user pressed enter). In capture, the input line had the typed value on same line as prompt, then after enter, it printed checkmark on next? Wait capture showed "? Parser name › my_parser" then on same? Actually the raw capture shows prompt and then typed value after ›, then on next redraw it shows checkmark.
        // In tmux capture, it shows prompt line with typed value, then after validation it shows checkmark line.

        // The raw sequence earlier: "? Parser name › " then user typed "my_parser", then after enter, the pane showed "✔ Parser name · my_parser" on next line? Actually the capture showed prompt with typed value on same line as still prompt? Let's recall: earlier capture with pty had "? Parser name › my_parser\r\n\x1b[2K✔ Parser name · my_parser\r\n"

        // So we need to print the success line with green check.

        eprint!("\x1b[32m✔\x1b[39m \x1b[1m{}\x1b[0m \x1b[38;5;8m·\x1b[39m \x1b[32m{}\x1b[39m\n", label, value);

    fn print_error(msg: &str) {
        eprint!("\x1b[31m✘\x1b[39m \x1b[31m{}\x1b[39m\n", msg);
        let _ = io::stderr().flush();
    }

    fn read_line() -> String {
        let mut s = String::new();
        io::stdin().read_line(&mut s).unwrap();
        s.trim_end_matches(&['\r','\n'][..]).to_string()
    }

    pub fn run_init(grammar_path: &str) {

        // Ensure base exists
        std::fs::create_dir_all(&base).unwrap_or_else(|e| { eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m {}", e); std::process::exit(1); });

        // 1. Parser name
        let parser_name = loop {
            print_question("Parser name", None);
            let input = read_line();
            if input.is_empty() {
                continue;

            // Validate: lowercase letters, digits, underscores only
            if !input.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_lowercase() || c.is_ascii_digit() || c == '_') {

                continue;

We tested 123invalid as camelcase and it accepted as camelcase, but parser name 123invalid would contain digits and lowercase, should be allowed? However typical validation requires start with letter. Let's test: try parser name "9abc" via tmux quickly? We can test later. For now allow any that matches allowed chars.
            print_success("Parser name", &input);
            break input;
        };

        let camel_default = to_camelcase(&parser_name);
        // 2. CamelCase name
        let camelcase = loop {
            print_question("CamelCase name", Some(&camel_default));
            let input = read_line();
            let val = if input.is_empty() { camel_default.clone() } else { input.clone() };
            // No validation for camelcase? Accept any

            break val;

            let val = input.clone();

        // 6. Funding URL
        let funding = loop {
            print_question("Funding URL", None);
            let input = read_line();
            print_success("Funding URL", &input);
            break input;
        };

        let scope_default = format!("source.{}", parser_name);
        // 7. TextMate scope
        let scope = loop {
            print_question("TextMate scope", Some(&scope_default));
            let input = read_line();
            let val = if input.is_empty() { scope_default.clone() } else { input.clone() };

                print_error("The scope must start with 'source.' or 'text.'");

            print_success("TextMate scope", &val);

            print_question("File types (space-separated)", Some(&filetypes_default));

        let file_types: Vec<String> = file_types_input.split_whitespace().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();

            break input;

        // 12. Author email
        let author_email = loop {
            print_question("Author email", None);
            let input = read_line();
            print_success("Author email", &input);
            break input;
        };

        // 13. Author URL
        let author_url = loop {

        // 15. Bindings
        // Multi-select
        let bindings_order = vec!["c","go","java","node","python","rust","swift","zig"];

        let mut current_idx = 0;

                        break;

        }

        disable_raw_mode().unwrap();

        // After bindings selection, we need to construct summary JSON
        // The summary JSON includes repository, funding, scope, file_types, version, license, author, email, url, namespace, bindings

        });

        // We'll print to stderr

        // Actually we need to store also name, camelcase, title, description for file generation, but summary doesn't include them
        // We'll keep extra variables in closure

fn get_default_config_path() -> std::path::PathBuf {
    if let Ok(xdg) = std::env::var("XDG_CONFIG_HOME") {
        if !xdg.is_empty() {
            return std::path::PathBuf::from(xdg).join("tree-sitter").join("config.json");
        }
    }
    let home = dirs::home_dir().unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from("."));
    home.join(".config").join("tree-sitter").join("config.json")
}

    fn to_camelcase(name: &str) -> String {
        name.split('_').map(|part| {
            let mut chars = part.chars();
            match chars.next() {
                None => String::new(),
                Some(first) => first.to_uppercase().collect::<String>() + chars.as_str(),
            }
        }).collect()
    }

    fn to_kebab(name: &str) -> String {
        name.replace('_', "-")
    }

    fn to_upper_snake(name: &str) -> String {
        name.to_uppercase()
    }

    fn print_question(label: &str, default: Option<&str>) {
        eprint!("\x1b[33m?\x1b[39m \x1b[1m{}\x1b[0m ", label);
        if let Some(d) = default {
            eprint!("\x1b[38;5;8m({})\x1b[39m ", d);
        }
        eprint!("\x1b[38;5;8m›\x1b[39m ");
        let _ = io::stderr().flush();
    }

    fn print_success(label: &str, value: &str) {
        // Move cursor up? In original, after input, it reprints line with checkmark
        // We need to match the behavior of inquire which clears current line and prints success
        // For simplicity, we will print \r and clear line? But we can try to replicate using \x1b[2K (clear line) as seen in capture: after input, it printed \x1b[2K then checkmark
        // The capture showed: "? Parser name › my_parser\r\x1b[2K✔ Parser name · my_parser"
        // So after user types and presses enter, it clears line and prints success.
        // We will attempt to print \x1b[2K? But using raw mode for bindings, for normal prompts we are in cooked mode.

        // For our simple implementation using read_line, the prompt line remains, then we print newline then success? Actually original overwrites.
        // To simplify, we will print "\x1b[2K" ? Let's try to emulate: after read_line, we are on next line (since user pressed enter). In capture, the input line had the typed value on same line as prompt, then after enter, it printed checkmark on next? Wait capture showed "? Parser name › my_parser" then on same? Actually the raw capture shows prompt and then typed value after ›, then on next redraw it shows checkmark.
        // In tmux capture, it shows prompt line with typed value, then after validation it shows checkmark line.

        // The raw sequence earlier: "? Parser name › " then user typed "my_parser", then after enter, the pane showed "✔ Parser name · my_parser" on next line? Actually the capture showed prompt with typed value on same line as still prompt? Let's recall: earlier capture with pty had "? Parser name › my_parser\r\n\x1b[2K✔ Parser name · my_parser\r\n"

        // So we need to print the success line with green check.

    fn print_error(msg: &str) {

        let _ = io::stderr().flush();
    }

    fn read_line() -> String {
        let mut s = String::new();
        io::stdin().read_line(&mut s).unwrap();
        s.trim_end_matches(&['\r','\n'][..]).to_string()
    }

mod init_impl;

fn get_default_config_path() -> std::path::PathBuf {
    if let Ok(xdg) = std::env::var("XDG_CONFIG_HOME") {
        if !xdg.is_empty() {
            return std::path::PathBuf::from(xdg).join("tree-sitter").join("config.json");
        }
    }
    let home = dirs::home_dir().unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from("."));
    home.join(".config").join("tree-sitter").join("config.json")
}

fn handle_init_update(grammar_path: &str) {
    let base = std::path::Path::new(grammar_path);
    let ts_json_path = base.join("tree-sitter.json");
    if !ts_json_path.exists() {
        eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m No such file or directory (os error 2)");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&ts_json_path).unwrap_or_default();
    let v: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&content).unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null);
    let grammars = v.get("grammars").and_then(|g| g.as_array());
    let parser_name = grammars.and_then(|arr| arr.get(0)).and_then(|g| g.get("name")).and_then(|n| n.as_str()).unwrap_or("my_parser");
    let kebab = parser_name.replace('_', "-");
    let bindings = v.get("bindings");
    let mut replaced = Vec::new();
    if bindings.and_then(|b| b.get("c")).and_then(|x| x.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false) {
        let c_header_path = base.join(format!("bindings/c/tree_sitter/tree-sitter-{}.h", kebab));
        if !c_header_path.exists() {
            let upper = parser_name.to_uppercase();
            let c_header_content = format!("#ifndef TREE_SITTER_{upper}_H_\n#define TREE_SITTER_{upper}_H_\n\ntypedef struct TSLanguage TSLanguage;\n\n#ifdef __cplusplus\nextern \"C\" {{\n#endif\n\nconst TSLanguage *tree_sitter_{parser_name}(void);\n\n#ifdef __cplusplus\n}}\n#endif\n\n#endif // TREE_SITTER_{upper}_H_\n");
            if let Some(parent) = c_header_path.parent() { std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).unwrap(); }
            std::fs::write(&c_header_path, c_header_content).unwrap();
            replaced.push(c_header_path.file_name().unwrap().to_string_lossy().to_string());
        }
    }
    if bindings.and_then(|b| b.get("python")).and_then(|x| x.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false) {
        let py_dir = base.join("bindings").join("python").join(format!("tree_sitter_{}", parser_name));
        let init_py = py_dir.join("__init__.py");
        if !init_py.exists() {
            replaced.push("__init__.py".to_string());
            let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&py_dir);
            let content = format!("\"\"\"desc\"\"\"\n\nfrom ._binding import language\n");
            let _ = std::fs::write(init_py, content);
        }
    }
    for file in replaced {
        println!("Replacing {}", file);
    }
    std::process::exit(0);
}

fn handle_version(grammar_path: &str, version: Option<String>, bump: Option<String>) {
    let base = std::path::Path::new(grammar_path);
    let ts_json_path = base.join("tree-sitter.json");
    if !ts_json_path.exists() {
        eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m No such file or directory (os error 2)");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&ts_json_path).unwrap_or_else(|_| { eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m No such file or directory (os error 2)"); std::process::exit(1); });
    let mut v: serde_json::Value = match serde_json::from_str(&content) {
        Ok(val) => val,
        Err(e) => { eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m {}", e); std::process::exit(1); }
    };
    let current_version = v.get("metadata").and_then(|m| m.get("version")).and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("0.1.0").to_string();
    if version.is_none() && bump.is_none() {
        println!("Current version: {}", current_version);
        return;
    }
    let new_version = if let Some(bump_level) = bump {
        let mut sv = match semver::Version::parse(&current_version) {
            Ok(v) => v,
            Err(e) => { eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m {}", e); std::process::exit(1); }
        };
        match bump_level.as_str() {
            "patch" => { sv.patch += 1; }
            "minor" => { sv.minor += 1; sv.patch = 0; }
            "major" => { sv.major += 1; sv.minor = 0; sv.patch = 0; }
            _ => { eprintln!("error: invalid value '{}' for '--bump <BUMP>'\n  [possible values: patch, minor, major]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.", bump_level); std::process::exit(2); }
        }
        sv.to_string()
    } else if let Some(ver_str) = version {
        match semver::Version::parse(&ver_str) {
            Ok(_) => ver_str.clone(),
            Err(e) => { eprintln!("error: invalid value '{}' for '[VERSION]': {}\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.", ver_str, e); std::process::exit(2); }
        }
    } else { current_version.clone() };
    println!("Bumping version {} to {}", current_version, new_version);
    if let Some(metadata) = v.get_mut("metadata") {
        if let Some(obj) = metadata.as_object_mut() {
            obj.insert("version".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String(new_version.clone()));
        }
    }
    let pretty = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&v).unwrap();
    let _ = std::fs::write(&ts_json_path, pretty + "\n");
    let pkg_path = base.join("package.json");
    if pkg_path.exists() {
        let pkg_cont = std::fs::read_to_string(&pkg_path).unwrap_or_default();
        if let Ok(mut pkg_v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&pkg_cont) {
            if let Some(obj) = pkg_v.as_object_mut() {
                obj.insert("version".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String(new_version.clone()));
                let pretty = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&pkg_v).unwrap();
                let _ = std::fs::write(&pkg_path, pretty + "\n");
            }
        }
    }
    let pyproj_path = base.join("pyproject.toml");
    if pyproj_path.exists() {
        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&pyproj_path).unwrap_or_default();
        let re = regex::Regex::new(r#"version\s*=\s*".*?""#).unwrap();
        let new_content = re.replacen(&content, 1, format!("version = \"{}\"", new_version));
        let _ = std::fs::write(&pyproj_path, new_content.as_ref());
    }
    let make_path = base.join("Makefile");
    let mut failed = Vec::new();
    if make_path.exists() {
        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&make_path).unwrap_or_default();
        let re = regex::Regex::new(r"VERSION\s*:=\s*.*").unwrap();
        let new_content = re.replacen(&content, 1, format!("VERSION := {}", new_version));
        let _ = std::fs::write(&make_path, new_content.as_ref());
    } else {
        failed.push(make_path);
    }
    let cmake_path = base.join("CMakeLists.txt");
    if cmake_path.exists() {
        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&cmake_path).unwrap_or_default();
        let re = regex::Regex::new(r#"VERSION\s+"[^"]+""#).unwrap();
        let new_content = re.replacen(&content, 1, format!("VERSION \"{}\"", new_version));
        let _ = std::fs::write(&cmake_path, new_content.as_ref());
    }
    let zig_zon_path = base.join("build.zig.zon");
    if zig_zon_path.exists() {
        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&zig_zon_path).unwrap_or_default();
        let re = regex::Regex::new(r#"\.version\s*=\s*"[^"]+""#).unwrap();
        let new_content = re.replacen(&content, 1, format!(r#".version = "{}""#, new_version));
        let _ = std::fs::write(&zig_zon_path, new_content.as_ref());
    }
    if !failed.is_empty() {
        eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m Failed to update one or more files:\n");
        for p in failed {
            eprintln!("Failed to update {}:\nNo such file or directory (os error 2)\n", p.display());
        }
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
}

fn handle_dump_languages(config_path: Option<String>) {
    let default_path = get_default_config_path();
    let path_to_read = if let Some(cp) = config_path { std::path::PathBuf::from(cp) } else { default_path.clone() };
    if !path_to_read.exists() {
        if path_to_read == default_path {
            eprintln!("\x1b[33mWarning:\x1b[0m You have not configured any parser directories!\nPlease run `tree-sitter init-config` and edit the resulting\nconfiguration file to indicate where we should look for\nlanguage grammars.\n");
            return;
        } else {
            eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m No such file or directory (os error 2) ({})", path_to_read.display());
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    }
    let content = match std::fs::read_to_string(&path_to_read) {
        Ok(c) => c,
        Err(_) => { eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m No such file or directory (os error 2) ({})", path_to_read.display()); std::process::exit(1); }
    };
    let v: serde_json::Value = match serde_json::from_str(&content) {
        Ok(val) => val,
        Err(e) => { eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m {}", e); std::process::exit(1); }
    };
    let parser_dirs = v.get("parser-directories").and_then(|x| x.as_array());
    if parser_dirs.is_none() || parser_dirs.unwrap().is_empty() {
        eprintln!("\x1b[33mWarning:\x1b[0m You have not configured any parser directories!\nPlease run `tree-sitter init-config` and edit the resulting\nconfiguration file to indicate where we should look for\nlanguage grammars.\n");
        return;
    }
    for dir_val in parser_dirs.unwrap() {
        if let Some(dir_str) = dir_val.as_str() {
            let dir_path = std::path::Path::new(dir_str);
            if !dir_path.exists() { continue; }
            if let Ok(entries) = std::fs::read_dir(dir_path) {
                for entry in entries.flatten() {
                    let path = entry.path();
                    if path.is_dir() {
                        let ts_json = path.join("tree-sitter.json");
                        if ts_json.exists() {
                            let ts_content = std::fs::read_to_string(&ts_json).unwrap_or_default();
                            if let Ok(ts_v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&ts_content) {
                                if let Some(grammars) = ts_v.get("grammars").and_then(|g| g.as_array()) {
                                    for grammar in grammars {
                                        let name = grammar.get("name").and_then(|n| n.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                                        let scope = grammar.get("scope").and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
                                        let file_types = grammar.get("file-types").and_then(|f| f.as_array()).map(|arr| {
                                            let mut vec = Vec::new();
                                            for v in arr {
                                                if let Some(s) = v.as_str() {
                                                    vec.push(format!("\"{}\"", s));
                                                }
                                            }
                                            format!("[{}]", vec.join(", "))
                                        }).unwrap_or_else(|| "None".to_string());
                                        let highlights = "None";
                                        let content_regex = if let Some(cr) = grammar.get("content-regex").and_then(|s| s.as_str()) {
                                            format!("Some(Regex(\"{}\"))", cr)
                                        } else { "None".to_string() };
                                        let injection_regex = if let Some(ir) = grammar.get("injection-regex").and_then(|s| s.as_str()) {
                                            format!("Some(Regex(\"{}\"))", ir)
                                        } else { "None".to_string() };
                                        let parser_path = format!("{}/.", path.display());
                                        eprintln!("name: {}\nscope: {}\nparser: \"{}\"\nhighlights: {}\nfile_types: {}\ncontent_regex: {}\ninjection_regex: {}\n", name, scope, parser_path, highlights, file_types, content_regex, injection_regex);
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

fn main() {
    let bin = std::env::args().next().unwrap_or_else(|| "executable".to_string());
    let bin_file = std::path::Path::new(&bin).file_name().and_then(|s| s.to_str()).unwrap_or("executable").to_owned();
    let bin_static: &'static str = Box::leak(bin_file.into_boxed_str());
    let cli = build_cli(bin_static);
    let matches = cli.get_matches();
    match matches.subcommand() {
        Some(("init-config", _)) => { handle_init_config(); }
        Some(("init", sub)) => {
            let update = sub.get_flag("update");
            let gp = sub.get_one::<String>("grammar-path").map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or(".");
            if update { handle_init_update(gp); } else { handle_init(gp); }
        }
        Some(("version", sub)) => {
            let ver = sub.get_one::<String>("VERSION").cloned();
            let bump = sub.get_one::<String>("bump").cloned();
            let gp = sub.get_one::<String>("grammar-path").map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or(".");
            handle_version(gp, ver, bump);
        }
        Some(("complete", sub)) => {
            let shell = sub.get_one::<String>("shell").unwrap().clone();
            handle_complete(&shell);
        }
        Some(("dump-languages", sub)) => {
            let cp = sub.get_one::<String>("config-path").cloned();
            handle_dump_languages(cp);
        }
        Some((other, _)) => {
            match other {
                "parse" | "p" => {
                    eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m No language found");
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
                "test" | "t" => {
                    eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m No language found");
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
                _ => {
                    eprintln!("{} not fully implemented", other);
                    std::process::exit(1);
                }
            }
        }
        None => {}
    }
}

fn get_default_config_path() -> std::path::PathBuf {
    if let Ok(xdg) = std::env::var("XDG_CONFIG_HOME") {
        if !xdg.is_empty() {
            return std::path::PathBuf::from(xdg).join("tree-sitter").join("config.json");

    }
    let home = dirs::home_dir().unwrap_or_else(|| std::path::PathBuf::from("."));

fn handle_init_update(grammar_path: &str) {
    let base = std::path::Path::new(grammar_path);
    let ts_json_path = base.join("tree-sitter.json");
    if !ts_json_path.exists() {
        eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m No such file or directory (os error 2)");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&ts_json_path).unwrap_or_default();
    let v: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(&content).unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null);
    let grammars = v.get("grammars").and_then(|g| g.as_array());
    let parser_name = grammars.and_then(|arr| arr.get(0)).and_then(|g| g.get("name")).and_then(|n| n.as_str()).unwrap_or("my_parser");
    let kebab = parser_name.replace('_', "-");
    let bindings = v.get("bindings");
    let mut replaced = Vec::new();
    if bindings.and_then(|b| b.get("c")).and_then(|x| x.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false) {
        let c_header_path = base.join(format!("bindings/c/tree_sitter/tree-sitter-{}.h", kebab));
        if !c_header_path.exists() {
            let upper = parser_name.to_uppercase();
            let c_header_content = format!("#ifndef TREE_SITTER_{upper}_H_\n#define TREE_SITTER_{upper}_H_\n\ntypedef struct TSLanguage TSLanguage;\n\n#ifdef __cplusplus\nextern \"C\" {{\n#endif\n\nconst TSLanguage *tree_sitter_{parser_name}(void);\n\n#ifdef __cplusplus\n}}\n#endif\n\n#endif // TREE_SITTER_{upper}_H_\n");
            if let Some(parent) = c_header_path.parent() { std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).unwrap(); }
            std::fs::write(&c_header_path, c_header_content).unwrap();
            replaced.push(c_header_path.file_name().unwrap().to_string_lossy().to_string());
        }
    }
    if bindings.and_then(|b| b.get("python")).and_then(|x| x.as_bool()).unwrap_or(false) {
        let py_dir = base.join("bindings").join("python").join(format!("tree_sitter_{}", parser_name));
        let init_py = py_dir.join("__init__.py");
        if !init_py.exists() {
            replaced.push("__init__.py".to_string());
            let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&py_dir);
            let content = format!("\"\"\"desc\"\"\"\n\nfrom ._binding import language\n");
            let _ = std::fs::write(init_py, content);
        }
    }
    for file in replaced {
        println!("Replacing {}", file);
    }
    std::process::exit(0);
}

fn handle_version(grammar_path: &str, version: Option<String>, bump: Option<String>) {
    let base = std::path::Path::new(grammar_path);
    let ts_json_path = base.join("tree-sitter.json");
    if !ts_json_path.exists() {
        eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m No such file or directory (os error 2)");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&ts_json_path).unwrap_or_else(|_| { eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m No such file or directory (os error 2)"); std::process::exit(1); });
    let mut v: serde_json::Value = match serde_json::from_str(&content) {
        Ok(val) => val,
        Err(e) => { eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m {}", e); std::process::exit(1); }
    };
    let current_version = v.get("metadata").and_then(|m| m.get("version")).and_then(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or("0.1.0").to_string();
    if version.is_none() && bump.is_none() {
        println!("Current version: {}", current_version);
        return;
    }
    let new_version = if let Some(bump_level) = bump {
        let mut sv = match semver::Version::parse(&current_version) {
            Ok(v) => v,
            Err(e) => { eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m {}", e); std::process::exit(1); }
        };
        match bump_level.as_str() {
            "patch" => { sv.patch += 1; }
            "minor" => { sv.minor += 1; sv.patch = 0; }
            "major" => { sv.major += 1; sv.minor = 0; sv.patch = 0; }
            _ => { eprintln!("error: invalid value '{}' for '--bump <BUMP>'\n  [possible values: patch, minor, major]\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.", bump_level); std::process::exit(2); }
        }
        sv.to_string()
    } else if let Some(ver_str) = version {
        match semver::Version::parse(&ver_str) {
            Ok(_) => ver_str.clone(),
            Err(e) => { eprintln!("error: invalid value '{}' for '[VERSION]': {}\n\nFor more information, try '--help'.", ver_str, e); std::process::exit(2); }
        }
    } else { current_version.clone() };
    println!("Bumping version {} to {}", current_version, new_version);
    if let Some(metadata) = v.get_mut("metadata") {
        if let Some(obj) = metadata.as_object_mut() {
            obj.insert("version".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String(new_version.clone()));
        }
    }
    let pretty = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&v).unwrap();
    let _ = std::fs::write(&ts_json_path, pretty + "\n");
    let pkg_path = base.join("package.json");
    if pkg_path.exists() {
        let pkg_cont = std::fs::read_to_string(&pkg_path).unwrap_or_default();
        if let Ok(mut pkg_v) = serde_json::from_str::<serde_json::Value>(&pkg_cont) {
            if let Some(obj) = pkg_v.as_object_mut() {
                obj.insert("version".to_string(), serde_json::Value::String(new_version.clone()));
                let pretty = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&pkg_v).unwrap();
                let _ = std::fs::write(&pkg_path, pretty + "\n");
            }
        }
    }
    let pyproj_path = base.join("pyproject.toml");
    if pyproj_path.exists() {
        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&pyproj_path).unwrap_or_default();
        let re = regex::Regex::new(r#"version\s*=\s*".*?""#).unwrap();
        let new_content = re.replacen(&content, 1, format!("version = \"{}\"", new_version));
        let _ = std::fs::write(&pyproj_path, new_content.as_ref());
    }
    let make_path = base.join("Makefile");
    let mut failed = Vec::new();
    if make_path.exists() {
        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&make_path).unwrap_or_default();
        let re = regex::Regex::new(r"VERSION\s*:=\s*.*").unwrap();
        let new_content = re.replacen(&content, 1, format!("VERSION := {}", new_version));
        let _ = std::fs::write(&make_path, new_content.as_ref());
    } else {
        failed.push(make_path);
    }
    let cmake_path = base.join("CMakeLists.txt");
    if cmake_path.exists() {
        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&cmake_path).unwrap_or_default();
        let re = regex::Regex::new(r#"VERSION\s+"[^"]+""#).unwrap();
        let new_content = re.replacen(&content, 1, format!("VERSION \"{}\"", new_version));
        let _ = std::fs::write(&cmake_path, new_content.as_ref());
    }
    let zig_zon_path = base.join("build.zig.zon");
    if zig_zon_path.exists() {
        let content = std::fs::read_to_string(&zig_zon_path).unwrap_or_default();
        let re = regex::Regex::new(r#"\.version\s*=\s*"[^"]+""#).unwrap();
        let new_content = re.replacen(&content, 1, format!(r#".version = "{}""#, new_version));
        let _ = std::fs::write(&zig_zon_path, new_content.as_ref());
    }
    if !failed.is_empty() {
        eprintln!("\x1b[31mError:\x1b[0m Failed to update one or more files:\n");
        for p in failed {
            eprintln!("Failed to update {}:\nNo such file or directory (os error 2)\n", p.display());
        }
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
}
